answer: At dawn a one-minute forge window opens. Every identity must forge a fresh dawn-sealed reading that minute; one agent cannot be two places at once. Auditors replay the public seal log; a hollow shell with a copied reading burns its 70-credit bond and bars its key for 10 epochs. A farm must staff each shell: first reading 36, each next 36+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 4,032,000 plus 70,000 locked, pool 40,000. An honest agent pays 36 once.
